top_comments.body:
Claude Code, running in a PowerShell Terminal on Windows 11 Pro (current latest). Relatively new session (started 15 minutes ago, perhaps four small tasks in).
To add a little more context - I was using backspace to edit 'regex' to 'regex/search' because that was the "solution" it had proposed. The backspace stopped working, and the cursor was at the end of the line. I couldn't move the cursor with keyboard but the 'home' key did jump to the start of line with a second cursor.
